title: Draft a quotation
summary: A quotation for one customer, from your price list, left as a draft for you to approve.

asks.label: The HSN or SAC code for this, if you know it:

text: Draft a quotation for [customer] for [what], valid until [valid]. Take every price from our price list and every term from our terms file, and invent nothing. Leave it as a draft for me to approve; do not send it to anyone. Then write a short read-back of what the quotation says, so I can check it before I approve it. If I give an HSN or SAC code here, use it for the item: [hsn]
